question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Conspicuous .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Conspicuous** means easily seen or noticed; attracting attention.
 
• Among the given options, only option 4 is correctly spelled as **Conspicuous**.
 
• All the other options (1, 2, and 3) are incorrect spellings of the word.

Correct sentence: *The spelling of the word is **Conspicuous**, which is used to describe something noticeable or prominent.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Examples of usage:**
 
 
• She wore a conspicuous red dress to the party, which caught everyone’s attention.
 
• The error in the report was conspicuous and needed immediate correction.
 
 
 
• **Synonyms:** noticeable, prominent, striking, obvious.
 
• **Antonyms:** inconspicuous, unnoticeable, hidden.
